name: Xpel Tea Tree Essential Oil 30ml
description:
Xpel Tea Tree Essential Oil 30ml

Experience the natural benefits of Xpel Tea Tree Essential Oil, a versatile oil formulated for both skin and hair care.

Key Benefits:

Skin & Hair Care: Ideal for acne-prone skin, scalp care, and maintaining healthy skin.

Antibacterial & Antifungal: Helps protect against bacteria, fungi, and other skin irritants.

Gentle & Natural: Safe for daily use on men and women, providing soothing care.

Pure Essential Oil: Contains high-quality Tea Tree Oil for maximum effectiveness.

Volume: 30ml | Brand: Xpel | Country of Origin: China
Suitable For: Men & Women | Purpose: Acne, Scalp, and Skin Care

Perfect for a natural, effective solution for skin and hair health.
